info.name: EODHD Financial Data Calendar Dividends & Splits API

params.name: ticker
params.description: Ticker symbol of the stock in the format {SYMBOL_NAME}.{EXCHANGE_ID} (e.g., 'AAPL.US' for NASDAQ or 'AAPL.MX' for the Mexican Stock Exchange).

params.name: from
params.description: Start date for data retrieval in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Defaults to earliest available data if not provided.

params.name: to
params.description: End date for data retrieval in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Defaults to latest available data if not provided.

params.name: fmt
params.description: Output format, either 'json' or 'csv'. Defaults to 'json'.

items.docs: Fetches historical dividend data for a specified stock symbol, including key dividend dates and values.
